title: estimation-collection/0.1
description: A set of estimation records plus what is true of the set: a paper's results (members with locators) or a session's or replication's timeline (events). Specification: spec/estimation.md section 11. A collection is an export built from records; each member stays a self-contained record, embedded or in a JSON Lines members file listed in attachments. Each member record is validated as an estimation record (core plus its claimed profiles) by the validator, not by this schema. Encoding, x-identifying, x-expected, x-vocabulary and x-level are as in estimation-0.1.json; a collection's members are judged by the record marks, its own fields by these (spec 11.7).

events.description: Level 4; events about workers and clients are level 5.

x-expected-by-kind.description: Checked by validators (spec 11.6): a warning when missing.

x-size-limits.description: fail_bytes applies to the collection file; the warnings to the collection without its embedded records; each member record is checked against the record limits as if alone. A members file has no overall limit.

kind.description: Sets which parts a validator expects: paper -> members with locators and a citation; session -> session and events; replication -> events and publication.

parent.description: id of the collection this one was lowered from (spec 11.7).

disclosure.description: How much the collection discloses (spec 4.9, 11.7): its own fields and every member record are at this level or below. A session or replication collection needs level 4 or more.

member.description: One record: embedded (record) or in the members file (attachment). Array order is the collection's order.

id.description: The record's meta.id; unique in the collection.

record.description: The record, embedded whole; validated as an estimation record.

attachment.description: id of the members file (attachments, role members) that holds the record.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the record's RFC 8785 canonical JSON, however it is stored. Optional.

label.description: The collection's own short name for the member.

locator.description: Where the result appears in the collection's publication; the collection's statement, not copied into the record.

session.description: One process that ran several fits (an interactive session, a manager job).

id.description: The id member records carry in provenance.execution.session.

fixed.description: What was fixed for the session, in the producer's terms: FE structure, weights, sample, declared variables.

member.description: id of the member it produced or concerns; set on every fit event.
